author: Lee Lawrence blanco
text:
These people are wonderful! Here with in an hour, knew the lay of the land, and fixed the problem quickly and efficiently. They know plants and were respectful of mine.
They have animals themselves, so they were extra nice to mine!
I cannot thank Bulldog enough for the fix; they knew what was wrong immediately and didn’t east time and energy figuring it out. The price was so reasonable, too. I give them an A+!

author: Nick Holmboe
text: As a Central Oregon native and real estate agent, I can’t say enough good things about Bulldog Septic. These folks are awesome :) professional, honest, and they truly care about my clients. They’re always thorough, on time, and easy to work with. Love partnering with them and proud to recommend them every chance I get!

author: Amanda Henkel
text: Rave Bulldog Septic saved the day! Thank you so much Stephanie Stout ! Fixed in less than 24hours! Came in under the price other companies quoted me! Thank you!

author: Scott Jones
text: I cant say enough good things about Bulldog Septic! After calling around on a Friday night. Stephanie assured me she would make it happen, and she sure did. she and Alan were incredibly helpful , professional and knowledgeable. the whole process was seamless and beyond pleased with the service they provided highly recommend Bulldog Septic for any one needing prompt, reliable septic service

author: Roy dunn
text: Service good office people bad. I had our septic pumped and drain fields tested. All was good but had to pay cash which was no problem. Then asked for a receipt because I dropped money in box at office and was told no receipt. Ill never use this outfit again. Unprofessional office workers. We're selling our house and now no proof that septic was done. Company is not even at the bottom of my page cause they fell off.
